title: Early Health Warning System
subtitle: Automated baseline & veterinary threshold deviation alerts with explainable reasons and follow-up tracking
disclaimer: Risk levels (Low, Medium, High) indicate observation priority based on baseline changes and simple thresholds — they are NOT disease probabilities or confirmed diagnoses. For High risk or severe signs, contact a veterinarian promptly.
noAlertsText: When a new health observation deviates from an animal's baseline or safe thresholds, an explainable alert will appear here.
followUpNotePlaceholder: e.g. Rechecked temperature after 4 hours; animal drank water and is resting in shade...
